integrity: The proof is analytical. The accompanying checker tests exact local matrices and illustrative finite trajectories; it does not independently certify an infinite theorem.
scientific_limitations: Deterministic finite-community MATE model only; strictly positive switching, dissatisfaction, predisposition and contacts as stated; conservative rate; not a full-state convergence or sharp-rate result. Priority bounded by inspected sources.
title: Uniform persistence and exponential full adoption in a multi-technology opinion network
